desc: Determine the maximum value in $S$ (or use $10^6$ as the limit).
Create a boolean array `present` of size $10^6 + 1$ marking which numbers exist in $S$.
Check if `present[A]`, `present[A+d]`, and `present[A+2d]` are all true. If so, increment `count`.
Run the code against Sample 1: Input `5\n8 3 1 5 2`, Expected Output `3`.
Run the code against Sample 2: Input `7\n300000 100000 499998 499999 200000 400000 500000`, Expected Output `5`.
Run the code against Sample 3: Input `10\n13 1 16 15 12 4 7 10 2 19`, Expected Output `10`.
